profile.headline: Software Craftsman | Agentic AI Enthusiast | Scalable Web
profile.summary:
15+ years engineering production systems across continents. I architect, code, and ship—from frontend performance to distributed backend infrastructure. Currently pioneering AI-powered automation and agentic workflows while maintaining the craft of clean, scalable code.

AI-First Systems: Integrating LLM agents, automation workflows, and intelligent tooling into production applications

High-Performance Web: SSR/ISR architectures with exceptional Core Web Vitals, reaching millions of users

Scalable Infrastructure: Microservices, GraphQL federation, and event-driven systems on AWS
Engineering Culture: Introduced modern stacks (Vue, React, GraphQL) and methodologies (TDD, atomic design) to growing teams

Recent Impact:
- Conducted 50+ Tech Designs alongside product team building up a resilient engineering platform 
- Architected federated GraphQL migration serving 2M+ requests/day
- Led frontend redesign improving conversion by 40% through performance optimization
- Built search infrastructure (Algolia + custom backend) processing 500K+ queries daily
- Designed monorepo architecture enabling 10+ teams to ship independently

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
🚀 Key Accomplishments

- Core Architect, ls-react-common: Spearheaded the development of the company’s hybrid design system, powering 22+ web and mobile applications across the enterprise.
- Engineered Multi-Service Signup System: Built and launched the core onboarding engine handling thousands of high-concurrency transactions daily.
- Frontend Board Member: Drove architectural decisions, standards, and tech stack alignment across web and mobile platforms (React, React Native, TypeScript, GraphQL, Node.js, Maestro).
- AI Tooling & Innovation Lead: Creator of Review Bot, an internal AI code reviewer that outperformed commercial alternatives like CodeRabbit by aligning strictly with custom company workflows.
- Agentic AI Pioneer: Key contributor to the LS Agentic Workflow initiative, building evaluation harnesses, RAG pipelines, model benchmark testing, and developer automations.
- Conducted more than 50 interviews hiring awesome people to the Engineering department 

💡 Current Focus

Copper Team (AI Engineering Enablement): Dedicated to empowering the broader engineering department with refined AI-driven boilerplates, agentic workflows, and internal tooling to dramatically accelerate software delivery.
positions.insights: Skills: React Native · Redux.js · TypeScript · Vue.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React.js · JavaScript · Harness Engineering · Deterministic LLM Programming · Control Systems Design
